pages.raw_title: Healthcare Technology Company Driving Pharma Innovation | OptimizeRx
pages.raw_meta: Learn how OptimizeRx, a leading healthcare technology company, connects life sciences with patients and HCPs through data-driven digital engagement.
raw_blocks: OptimizeRx provides best-in-class health technology that enables care-focused engagement between life sciences organizations, healthcare providers, and patients.

To combine human ingenuity, artificial intelligence, and technology to help life-science marketers evolve their approach, transform their customer relationships, and connect patients with the best possible treatments.
At OptimizeRx, we believe in the power of connection to drive meaningful health outcomes.

Founded as a healthcare technology company in 2006, OptimizeRx began by delivering coupons and co-pay assistance directly to physicians and pharmacists through EHR and ePrescribing platforms. Today, we’ve evolved into a leading healthcare technology partner, blending human expertise with AI to help life science marketers transform engagement, strengthen customer connections, and ensure patients access the treatments they need.

We deliver clear, actionable strategies that help pharmaceutical brands overcome real-world challenges. By aligning the right message with the right moment, we drive stronger brand engagement and, ultimately, betterpatient care.

We work side by side with clients to understand their unique challenges and deliver strategies that drive measurable impact. Our partnerships are built on shared goals, transparency, and a focus on achieving results that matter.

We focus on measurable impact. Our solutions help clients plan and activate campaigns that accelerate decision-making, increase engagement, and convert opportunities into real results—delivering stronger brand performance and tangible ROI.

We are committed to attracting, nurturing, and retaining a passionate, diverse, and talented team of experts who enjoy what they do.

pages.raw_title: Performance-Driven Pharma Marketing for Agencies | OptimizeRx
pages.raw_meta: Performance-driven pharma marketing from OptimizeRx helps agencies activate precise HCP and patient audiences, optimize media, and drive measurable results.
raw_blocks: Execute Every Campaign at a Higher Level

Great marketing strategies deserve superior execution partners. OptimizeRx helps agencies deliver performance-driven pharma marketing with the intelligence, reach, and technology to turn ambitious plans into high-performing campaigns. • Plan with greater intelligence. Build brand-specific HCP and consumer audiences and understand where and how to reach them. ‍ • Activate with greater precision. Reach audiences around key patient journey moments across point of care and omnichannel media. ‍ • Optimize and prove performance. Continuously improve targeting and give clients transparent, independently validated results.
Healthcare Intelligance Built for Pharma
Draw on more than 20 years of proprietary EHR data alongside robust consumer health and media intelligence to inform more precise audience and media decisions.
Point of Care Reach at Scale
Extend omnichannel plans into the clinical workflow through OptimizeRx’s network of 400+ EHR and ePrescribing platforms, giving brands a presence at moments when treatment decisions are being made.
HCP & DTC Marketing, Synchronized
Coordinate provider and consumer engagement around the same patient journey milestones to create more relevant, connected campaigns across point of care and omnichannel media.
Campaigns run with OptimizeRx consistently deliver measurable, third-party verified impact—including higher script conversion, new brand writers, shorter time to therapy start, and more.
Support for Every Stage of Campaign Execution
However your team works, OptimizeRx can support your process with intelligence, technology, activation, and measurement capabilities to move from client brief to measurable impact.
Build a Smarter Foundation with Unique Intelligence

Turn client objectives into precise, actionable marketing plans with OptimizeRx. Identify who matters most, understand where they can be reached, and refine audience strategies based on quality, scale, channel opportunity, and campaign goals, so you can move faster from brief to launch.

Tap into OptimizeRx intelligence in the way that works best for your team. Work directly with us to draw on 20+ years of proprietary EHR data, plus robust consumer health and media intelligence. You can also access those insights on demand through our Natural Language Audience Builder (NLAB) to create brand-specific, coordinated HCP and consumer audiences in minutes, complete with media channel propensity insights.
The result: Earlier access to key audience and media planning insights, for a strategy that holds up to client scrutiny.

Reach your priority HCPs and consumers where and when they are most likely to engage and take action. OptimizeRx’s predictive targeting, powered by our Dynamic Audience Activation Platform (DAAP) makes it easy to align media flighting around key milestones in the patient journey, so brand messaging engages audiences where and when it has the most utility and impact.

Activate HCP and consumer audiences independently or synchronize both sides of the campaign around the same patient journey moments —coordinating messaging across point of care and omnichannel media to create greater relevance and impact.
Choose the model that works for your team, with managed activation through OptimizeRx or self-service options that give agencies greater control over campaign execution.
The result: More efficient media investments and higher brand conversion, so each media dollar goes further.
Learn, Improve, and Prove the Impact

DAAP continuously learns from campaign performance, feeding real-world response signals back into its predictive models to automatically refine targeting and improve activation over time. As the campaign runs, the system gets smarter about which audiences, moments, and opportunities are most likely to drive results.

With third-party validated measurement, physician-level transparency, and clear reporting, you’ll be able to show exactly where impact is coming from—building confidence in your work and creating results you’re excited to share with clients.
The result: Increased, provable ROI that validates your strategic choices and delights your life science clients.
Patient-centric EHR strategies expanded reach and lifted prescriptions for a rare sleep therapy.
OptimizeRx used AI targeting to engage hypersomnia providers at key EHR moments, boosting prescriptions by 44% and growing the prescriber base.
AI powers omnichannel campaign performance to help an oral chemotherapy brand drive measurable NRx growth.
Targeted messaging reached oncologists across EHR and digital channels. The campaign delivered a 10.5% script lift and 7.4:1 ROI.
Healthcare marketing isn’t getting easier. That’s why we’re here.
Bring an NPI list, send an RFP, or just tell us your objective – we’ll help shape the next step.
